system.description: During Downtime, you can perform a death-defying act for the crowds of the Kettlewhistle Fair or a Gaslake gin house. Test Agility (DR14). Triumph: earn 2d6 × 10 s, and someone in the crowd wants to hire you. Success: earn d6 × 10 s. Failure: you earn nothing but bruises. Ruin: you fall badly, and begin your next adventure with one wound.
